summary: Kerb lined with parked cars beside a fenced building site and bush.
reasons: Cars park nose to tail on this kerb
Fenced construction site and bush alongside
Dormitories only at the far end

best_section.where: east kerb of Coldridge Street beside the construction site hoarding

drivers.seclusion: Hoarding and bush on the east, tree belt and field across the road; nearest dormitory about 30 m past the section end.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane wide enough for a row of parked cars; a van fits in line.
drivers.traffic: Two-way campus road, moderately busy; cars park along it all day.
drivers.convention: Dense parking along the kerb in Esri, so a van blends in.

flags: Works Zone signs along this kerb; check on site
sun_shade: Open to afternoon sun from the west; tree shade across the road in the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the works zone is enforced overnight
